board: Winsen ZE08-CH2O formaldehyde module with 7-pin 1.25 mm cable
reason: Modelled from the Winsen ZE08-CH2O manual V1.0: active-upload 9-byte frame FF 17 04 00 CH CL 13 88 SUM (ppb, checksum NOT(sum bytes1-7)+1) streamed once a second at 9600 baud; the driver resyncs and verifies the checksum, and also supports the Q&A commands. Pin order 1-7 (HD, DAC, GND, VIN, RXD, TXD, PWM) is from the manual's pin table; the part is cabled because its connector is 1.25 mm pitch. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico.
breakoutPinoutSource: Winsen ZE08-CH2O user's manual V1.0, Table 2 pin description and pin figure (https://static.chipdip.ru/lib/395/DOC036395650.pdf); https://www.winsen-sensor.com/sensors/ch2o-gas-sensor/ze08-ch2o.html
